tier_3_high_disagreement.description: Resource-estimation study of intermediate-qutrit decomposition for quantum arithmetic operations used in gate-based derivative pricing, including addition/subtraction, multiplication/division, square root, exponential, and arcsine, with a comparative analysis against prior qubit-only Toffoli decompositions.
